caveats: ALL counts in this file are SAMPLE counts. The Aspire REST surface exposes no $count/total, so no population figure could be obtained for anything.

Sample window: 425 install opportunities created 2026-09-15..2026-09-30 (15 days), fetched newest-first. Every one of them has OpportunityType='Work Order' - no 'Contract'-type opportunities fell in the window, so the group vocabulary is the vocabulary of work orders/change orders, which may differ from new-construction bid estimates.

Division mix of the fetched opportunities is heavily skewed: IN-LA 370, IN-IRR 50, IN-SUB 2, IN-HS 1, IN-LD 1, IN-SO 1, IN-MC 0. Group-name evidence for the Sod, Hardscape, Design and Marketing sections is therefore thin even though Pavers/Hardscape groups do appear (they sit on IN-LA opportunities).

The MCP transport caps each response at roughly 250 KB, which truncated many OpportunityServices windows. Gaps were refilled with follow-up $filter range windows, but the service<->group join is still incomplete: 955 install line rows were captured across 159 of the 238 sampled install opportunities (and 290-ish of the 715 sampled install groups). The uncaptured rows are whole OpportunityServiceGroupID sub-ranges, which is arbitrary with respect to group name, so the group->service mapping should not be biased - but every per-service and per-group line count is an UNDERCOUNT, not a total.

'Install: Enhancements' (DivisionID 1576) is DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: its DivisionCode is 'INEN' (no hyphen), so it does not match DivisionCode LIKE 'IN-%'. It is Active=false and its only ServiceType (2618 'Irrigation Service DO NOT USE') has zero services in the catalog, so nothing is lost - but the filter choice is a choice.

Division IN-LD is named 'Design: Landscape and Irrigation Design'. It matches the IN-% filter and is included here, but it is DESIGN work, not install labour. Whether Design is a level-1 section of the install estimate or a separate thing is a product decision this extract cannot make.
ServiceTypes 2552, 6645, 6646, 6647, 6648, 6649 and 6650 exist but have ZERO services - the real design services all hang off ServiceType 6643. Do not create empty level-1 sections from them.

SortOrder is 0 for every one of the 48 install services and null for most install ServiceTypes (only 7367/7369 have SortOrder=1). Aspire carries no usable display ordering for this catalog; ordering must be decided by us.
ContractService is false for 46 of the 48 install services; only 50780 'Paver Subcontractor' and 50803 'Aquatic Spray Service 4' are true.

Group names are free text and the sample contains one-off junk: street addresses ('11245 Rolling Fork Trl- Replace Street Tree', 'Bldg 26- 1308 Chopin Ln'), per-unit price notes ('Irrigation = $2,904 / Unit'), model names ('Landscape - GRAND BAY HEAVEN MODEL') and typos ('Customer Satisfacting'). Normalisation here is lowercase + whitespace-collapse only; raw strings are preserved.

'Default Group' (58 sampled groups) is Aspire's unnamed-group default, not a real section. It carries a mixture of services (18878, 18882, 18888, 18890, 18883, 18945, 18879) and must not be seeded as a section.
mcp__aspire__mssql_* was unavailable for the whole of this extraction (every call times out), so nothing here was cross-checked against the Aspire SQL replica.

One probe response was not archived verbatim: Opportunities $orderby=OpportunityID desc&$top=3 (a schema probe). Its one install row (OpportunityID 2902847) IS in opportunities_install.page1.json; its two maintenance rows (2902848, 2902846, both MT-IR) are out of scope for this extract and were not transcribed. Every other response is archived under scripts/data/aspire_raw/ (local only, gitignored).

optional_services.rule: 'Optional Services' is NOT a ServiceType-derived section. In Aspire it is an ordinary group whose OptionalServiceGroup flag is true; the services inside it come from the normal install catalog (sample: 18882 Landscape Install ×89, 18878 Irrigation Install ×9, 50697 Hardscape Install ×9, 18890 Subcontractor ×1). Model it as a boolean on the section/line, not as a 10th section.

unplaceable_or_flagged.name: IN: Subcontractor
unplaceable_or_flagged.issue: Single catch-all service used for EVERY subcontracted trade. In the sample it appears under 7 distinct sub-trade group names (Sod - Subcontractor, Artificial Turf, Espalier, Littoral, Well/Pump, Direction Bore, Pump Station) plus 'Sod' and 'Default Group'. The sub-trade lives only in the free-text group name / line DisplayName, never in the Service. A one-Service->one-Section rule collapses all subs into one section; if the UI needs per-trade subcontractor sections they must come from somewhere other than the Aspire Service.

unplaceable_or_flagged.name: MC: 90 Day Landscape Maintenance
unplaceable_or_flagged.issue: Appears 8x on install opportunities under the group '90 - Day Maintenance', but it belongs to ServiceType 2608 'Maintenance Contract Mow' in division MT-CT, so the DivisionCode LIKE 'IN-%' filter EXCLUDES it and it is NOT in `services`. If the app needs a '90-Day Maintenance' section on install estimates, this service must be added by hand.
